_readme: Zones below were placed by visually inspecting real frames from demo/videos/vtest.avi (the same OpenCV sample clip used for the real false-positive benchmark, docs/PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md) -- they are grounded in actual visible content in that footage (a taped-off restricted area, a real pedestrian chokepoint, the only vehicle-parking area in frame, a signpost pause-point), NOT clicked interactively, and NOT the team's actual demo camera. scripts/define_zone.py needs a live GUI + mouse clicks that only a human operator can provide -- it could not be run non-interactively. Once real demo footage/camera exists, run: python scripts/define_zone.py --source <your camera or video> --zone-id <id> --zone-type <fence|boundary|checkpoint|verification> --name <name> --camera-id edge-001 -- to replace these with genuinely correct coordinates. See docs/LIMITATIONS.md.

zones.name: Perimeter Fence Line — Taped Restricted Area
